text: 40 companies seek 3,000 candidates at job fair in HCM City

The University of Economics Ho Chi Minh City (UEH) organised the "Ho Chi Minh City Internship and Job Fair 2026" from November 5 to 8, offering more than 3,000 job opportunities from 40 participating companies.

Vacancies span a wide range of industries, including banking, finance, insurance, securities, accounting, auditing, consulting, technology, e-commerce, construction, real estate, trade, import-export, logistics, manufacturing, materials, energy, and design technology.
At the company booths, candidates had the opportunity to learn about available positions, job requirements, and career prospects while interacting directly with company representatives.
One-on-one interviews allowed applicants to showcase their capabilities and enabled employers to assess potential candidates more effectively.
Prior to the event, UEH organized various preparatory activities to help participants get ready for recruitment opportunities.
The talk show "Three Generations, One Labor Market" kicked off the program series, offering diverse perspectives on careers and employment trends.
Workshops such as "Data Analysis & Visualization" and "CD EXPO: Step Into Sales FMCG" equipped students with essential skills for their future careers.
In addition, the workshop "Emotional Intelligence: Building Inner Strength for Career Readiness" provided valuable insights into the role of emotional intelligence in career development.
Resume review sessions and mock interviews with experts also helped applicants refine their application materials and become familiar with recruitment processes.
A highlight of the event was the AI Career Zone, which introduced innovative tools such as AI Review CV, AI Career Advisor, and AI Resume Scanner.
These tools support candidates in preparing their resumes, exploring career pathways, and gaining greater confidence as they enter the workforce.

The job fair reflects UEH's ongoing efforts to connect students and job seekers with employers while promoting career readiness through both professional training and advanced AI-powered career services.
